_comment: Phase-3 gate bullet 4: continuation contracts for every declared hook, MACHINE-CHECKED against the pristine image. mod/hook_caves.yaml declares delay_slot policy and clobbers; nothing verified them until now. A site whose contract cannot be proven is REFUSED with a reason — never emitted as a passing contract, because a wrong contract launders an assertion into a machine-checked claim. Reports; never rewrites. Regenerate: tools/phase3_hook_contract.py

patched_image_pin.note: the discharge image is the FULL 4-code-mod build, pinned by hash. If the on-disk image does not match the pin, the tool does NOT trust it (discharge falls back to 'owed') — the stale-image hole the audit caught.

summary._comment: An OBLIGATION is not a defect: `clobbers` DECLARES the registers a cave intentionally changes (a gameplay mod's purpose) or uses as scratch. The post-build ACCOUNTING discharges a hook when every live register it writes is declared, saved/restored, or reproduced — i.e. it corrupts nothing UNDECLARED. A VIOLATION is a hard defect (undeclared clobber of a witnessed-live register, k0/k1, split load, no terminal j, unreimplemented branch). DEGRADED = discharge over a recovered/undecoded frame (honest can't-be-sure). A REFUSAL means the contract is not computable / the site is structurally unsafe, and needs human review.

obligations.why: these are LIVE at the hook site and DECLARED as clobbered. The cave must either intentionally change them (declared) or save/restore them; anything live it writes UNDECLARED is a corruption. Resolved by the post-build accounting.

liveness.method: intra-function CFG backward-liveness fixpoint over delay-slot-aware basic blocks; lattice = 32 GPRs + HI/LO/COP2. At a call, def=caller-saved (the o32 ABI the game was compiled to — the one assumption in the unsafe direction, stated) and use=the callee's arity (a cheap use-before-def pre-pass). LIVE is otherwise OVER-approximated (both branch edges, EXIT/tail/ALL boundary seeds) so it can reject a safe hook but never accept an unsafe one. Obligations computed at the RESUME point minus the displaced defs the cave reproduces. A SECOND witnessed-only solution (no boundary seeds, no arity) drives the hard-violation escalation, so a working mod is never accused on an inferred may-read.

bypass_paths.why_benign: the interior target is the DELAY SLOT, and it is a `nop` in BOTH the pristine and the patched image — so those paths execute the same nop and continue to the same place. Behaviour is preserved.
bypass_paths.what_it_means: these paths SKIP THE CAVE. That is correct only if they do not need it. REVIEW ONCE, then it is a property of the patch, not a hazard.
